svg.title: Glitter map
svg.text: Where cosmetic glitter goes (dashed green) and where it never goes (red hatched). Lesson 06.2, project 8.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
1 Cheekbones up to the temples · 2 Hairline and parting · 3 Forehead center · also collarbones
No glitter: eyelids, lash line, the skin just under the eyes, lips
Glitter goes on a thin base (cosmetic glitter gel, or aloe gel / a little petroleum jelly on the body). Pat, don't rub.
